_meta.purpose: Catalog of sources checked live (HTTP status + extracted content sampled) for the CSS (Central Superior Services Examination, Pakistan) knowledge base notebook. CSS here always means the FPSC civil-service exam, never Cascading Style Sheets.
_meta.checked_on: 2026-11-17, follow-up additions and SSL/classification fixes verified 2026-11-18
_meta.method: Verified with direct HTTP requests (curl) and, for PDFs/pages, by actually extracting text (PyMuPDF / trafilatura) and inspecting it -- not from search-result snippets alone. URLs that returned 404 when checked directly were dropped even if a search engine or a third-party site referenced them.
_meta.note: FPSC's site (fpsc.gov.pk) is a client-rendered app whose document filenames/paths change every exam cycle. Treat every fpsc.gov.pk URL below as valid as of the date above; re-verify before relying on it later.

pdf_sources.subject: All compulsory and ~42 optional subjects (see subjects_detected)
pdf_sources.topic: Official CSS Syllabus (Scheme, Marks and Subject Topics)
pdf_sources.source_title: Revised Syllabi for CSS Competitive Examination (FPSC; dated "Updated on: 7th July, 2015" for CE-2016 and onwards)
pdf_sources.description: 158-page official FPSC document: the exam scheme (1200 total marks, 600 compulsory + 600 optional across 7 groups), the full optional-subject group list, and a detailed topic-by-topic syllabus for every compulsory subject (English Essay, English Precis & Composition, General Science & Ability, Current Affairs, Pakistan Affairs, Islamic Studies/Comparative Study of Major Religions) and dozens of optional subjects.
pdf_sources.reliability: official (FPSC) -- but accessed via an Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshot (captured 2024-11-04), NOT a currently live fpsc.gov.pk URL. The original fpsc.gov.pk path (/assets/media/2024-10-22-01-45-26-Syllabus_for_CE-2016_and_onwards.pdf) 404s as of 2026-11-17 -- the site has since migrated to a different URL structure and the live site's Syllabuses section only serves unrelated general-recruitment PDFs for CS-2027 (verified; see excluded_or_failed). Third-party CSS-prep sites report the compulsory structure/marks are unchanged through the 2026/2027 cycles, but this was NOT independently confirmed against a live FPSC source this session -- verify currency before treating any specific topic or mark as still authoritative for CE-2027.

verified.note: FIXED in a follow-up session: the original heading-detection regex required every word of the subject name to start with a letter, which silently broke on names containing '&' or a parenthetical as their own word (e.g. 'ENGLISH (PRECIS & COMPOSITION)', 'GENERAL SCIENCE & ABILITY') -- those pages matched nothing and inherited the previous heading. The regex now captures everything between 'PAPER:' and the first '(<N> MARKS)' non-greedily across lines; re-verified locally to detect all 52 subjects listed in the document's own index (a couple fire twice across a multi-page intro, which is harmless -- same label both times).

excluded_or_failed.note: UPDATE (follow-up session): the detailed subject-by-subject syllabus was NOT found at any live fpsc.gov.pk URL (the site's current Syllabuses section only serves unrelated general-recruitment PDFs regardless of query), but an Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshot of FPSC's own 2015-dated document was found and verified -- see pdf_sources[0] above.
